item.title: Rancher's story to Trump highlights why Arizona Governor Katie Hobbs should be defeated in midterms
Trump-aligned MAGA Inc. invests $10 million in Ken Paxton's Texas Senate race against James Talarico
item.description: MAGA Inc. spends $10 million on ads supporting Ken Paxton in a tight Texas Senate race against James Talarico, which could influence the midterm elections.

item.title: FBI captures fugitive from 'Most Wanted' list overseas, accused of $600K fraud
MS-13 gang member with machete, wanted for murder, released by Biden-appointed judge, says DHS
item.description: A convicted MS-13 killer known as "La Bruja" is free in California after a federal judge ruled ICE held him without a required bond hearing.
